email.subject1: more pipeline for PureLogics, same team
email.body1:
Bryan, saw PureLogics has scaled past $38.7M in revenue with a 400-plus team pushing AI-driven custom software across healthcare and insurance.

Growth like that usually means more in-market accounts than business development can actually touch, and that is where good-fit deals quietly go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PureLogics off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: a quick teardown of your outbound
email.body2:
Bryan, quick follow-up for PureLogics.

Services firms competing for the same Fortune 500 logos usually win on speed of follow-up, not volume, yet most BD reps lose hours to research and CRM instead of conversations. Tightening that motion is often where the easy lift hides.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent, and I will tailor it to your healthcare and insurance targets.
email.body3:
Bryan, last bit of proof for PureLogics.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PureLogics' reply rate likely compares to other software services firms your size. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bryan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling BD pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know a 400-person services shop has plenty competing for attention right now.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a custom-software BD motion? I will tailor it to PureLogics either way.
